question: Are the 679 exact-state source-preimage mismatches genuine changes to pivot parents/resolvents, or are they entirely explained by the mandatory subsumption_minimize(pool) normal-form stage after exact pivot-1 resolution?
checks_per_mismatch: rebuild the same frozen source witness, sealed R50G24 pair, and exact-minimum cover
compare pivot-1 positive parents before/after cover lift
compare pivot-1 negative parents before/after cover lift
compare full non-tautological pivot-1 resolvents before/after cover lift
compare actual lifted DP transform with subsumption_minimize(canonical(target_post_DP + cover))
partition removed target clauses and removed cover clauses by subsumption direction
measure whether the original BCE/BVE debt obligations remain available in the actual minimized post-DP state
run same-pivot R47J and independent macro replay on the actually lifted source

classification.SUBSUMPTION_ONLY_NORMAL_FORM_PREIMAGE: pivot parents/resolvents unchanged and actual DP output equals mandatory subsumption-normalization of target+cover
classification.GENUINE_DP_NONCOMMUTATION: pivot parents/resolvents change or the normalized expected state still differs from actual DP output
classification.R47J_REPLAY_FAILURE: actual lifted source cannot pass independent same-pivot R47J replay
